integrity: Self-contained algebraic proof and reproducible F3 finite-field spot checks; no independent audit or certification. No invented experimental generality.
scientific_limitations: Only characteristic 3 and n>=4; for n=2 modulo 9 the full nonreduced Jacobian scheme at the common diagonal is not claimed. Broader dimension and coordinate multiplicity results already exist. Literature-equivalent formulations remain possible.
title: A mod-nine singularity stratification for elementary-symmetric cubic hypersurfaces in characteristic three
